title: Sources of finance
caption: Internal sources cost no interest but are limited. External finance splits by time and by kind: short-term debt, longer-term debt, new equity, and other sources such as grants and crowdfunding.
alt: Five boxes: internal sources; external short-term; external medium and long-term; equity; other (government grants, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer lending).
description: Internal: retained profit, better working capital management, sale of assets.
External short-term: overdrafts, trade credit, invoice factoring and discounting.
Medium and long-term: bank loans, leasing and hire purchase, bonds and debentures.
Equity: new shares, business angels, venture capital, a stock market listing.
Other: government grants, crowdfunding and peer-to-peer lending.
